title: MV Plugin requests associated with Yanfly Equip Requirements and Yanfly Item Synthesis regarding the behavior of armors and equip menu

posts.author: LUKElcs
posts.body:
Context: I have 2 accessory slots. (EquipCore + Equip Requirements)
There are a set of accessories that are upgrades of each other.  Having multiple equipped at the same time would be detrimental to the balance.  As such, you can only have one of them equipped at a time.
The following is applied to each item in the set:
<Custom Equip Requirement Condition>
const accs = [10,12,14,16];
condition = !accs.some(acc => user.isEquipped($dataArmors[acc]));
</Custom Equip Requirement Condition>
Problem: When one item in the set is equipped, it cannot be swapped directly for another item in the set.  It must first be unequipped and then another item in the set selected.  This is problematic for multiple reasons, and in-practice, very unintuitive within the context of my game.
Expected difficulty: likely too difficult for plugin support? But I could be wrong.
Suggested course of action: editing the base javascript code for the equip menu.
Context:  I am using Yanfly Item Synthesis to craft new accessories.
Some accessories use weaker accessories as ingredients for the new upgraded version (the set of items I mentioned earlier).
Problem: If an armor used in a recipe is equipped, it isn't detected as usable.  That doesn't suite my purposes.
I want Item Synthesis to count equipped Armors and Weapons as usable ingredients.
Expected difficulty: Unsure
Suggested course of action: I imagine you could add player equipment to the plugins list of places to check to see if the ingredients are there, but it might be more complicated than that.
Context: I want to make sure everything is explained clearly
Problem: I think I sound like a robot lmao, I assure you I AM a REAL HUMAN, I have blood and flesh just like you. xd
All installed plugins are shown below.  Some are custom or simple tweak scripts made with the help of the amazing people here on the forums, usually named after the user name and then what it is it does.
